name: KK 17 (Hubble)
blurb: KK 17, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: kk17-hubble
story: KK 17 is a faint dwarf with only weak signs of young stars, traveling in a loose association with the galaxies NGC 784 and UGC 1281. Hubble measured its distance to ask whether groups of dwarf galaxies are pools of mostly dark matter.

claims.text: KK 17 is a Magellanic irregular galaxy
KK 17 is a dwarf with only weak signs of young (Population I) stars
KK 17 belongs to the 17+6 association with NGC 784 and UGC 1281
Hubble program 10210 'Groups of Dwarf Galaxies: Pools of Mostly Dark Matter?' measured distances to dwarf galaxies in dwarf groups
